question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the questions mark (?)in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f54ad2bb35548ce51356e61d1a716f461cc03edbc5232f7c8df05e15fcd546b6.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

**⇒Logic : The number of triangles in the box are increasing in an odd number series.**

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab193ae3f0cf5dde24b0920aa4794303e0b5edc2b99f3914db939de590623563.png] 

As, the number of triangles in the box are increasing in an odd number series, therefore ;

 
• First box - 1 triangle
 
• Second box - 3 triangles 
 
• Third box - 5 triangles 
 
• **Fourth box - 7 triangles ****​**

Thus, the only box which has 7 triangles is option- (2).

Hence, **"Option - (2)"** is the correct answer.
